hypothesis: The overflow-safe Fa_01 work queue is under-served by ten ordinary-day hands; a small fixed increase can convert queued crop and animal work into terminal cash after Fibonacci hire cost.
isolated_change: Ordinary-day target hands only. Final-day ten-hand branch, expansion, crop plan, herd, market logic, routing, and overflow threshold remain unchanged.

development_gate.selection_rule: Among variants passing every condition, select the highest parent mean margin; ties use fewer hands. If none pass, kill the daily-labor hypothesis.

provenance_gate.required_git_head_at_start: commit containing this config and all three source snapshots

validation_rule: A selected source must be copied byte-for-byte into a new named production path and registered with unused sealed seeds before validation or Save & Run.
